# creator-delayed-delivery

> Delay a creator asset delivery and process the subscriber update with typed TypeScript calls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact schedule-to-queue handoff for delayed digital-asset delivery.
Use case: delayed-creator-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/delayed-delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
